sources.title: BigBang — Pursuing Open-Ended Intelligence through Self-Evolving ...
sources.snippet: BigBang is a general-purpose large language model evolved from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B through efficient post-training, driven by an adversarial, self-evolving synthetic data framework grounded in verifiable frontier research tasks. BigBang reaches aggregate performance between DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) and DeepSeek V4 Pro (1.6T).
